project_context.name: Rone Batista - Muaythai Coach Landing Page
project_context.target_audience: Potential private Muaythai students in Itapeva-SP
project_context.aesthetic: Modern, elite sports/martial identity, raw, dark, disciplined, high-contrast, premium.

typography.heading_strategy: Bebas Neue for H1/H2 (uppercase, tracking-tight), Barlow for H3/H4 and body. Avoid Inter/Roboto entirely.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Strictly NO soft shadows. Use 1px solid strokes (border-border) and 2px inner glow for highlights.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges (rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm) for a raw, martial tactical feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on dark backgrounds to add grit and remove digital flatness.

component_styling.buttons: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none), high contrast. Primary CTA is Blood Red (#DC2626) with White text. Hover: -translate-y-1, brighter red, subtle red drop-shadow. No generic transitions.
component_styling.cards: Flat background (#141414), 1px solid border (#262626), no drop shadow. On hover: slight lift, border changes to primary (red) or secondary (gold) color.
component_styling.icons: Use lucide-react, large sizes, stroke-width 1.5. Tint icons toward primary or secondary colors.
component_styling.accordion: Flat styling, high-contrast borders between items, plus/minus icon indicators.

layouts.general: Generous spacing (py-24, py-32). Mobile-first responsive grids. Optical alignment over mathematical alignment.
layouts.hero: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center, strong left alignment, heavy background image overlay (bg-black/70 to bg-black/90). Let the hero text dominate.
layouts.about: Asymmetric bento/split layout (e.g., md:grid-cols-12, image col-span-5, text col-span-7). Use negative space effectively.
layouts.formats: 3 columns (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) gap-8. High density but sharp, cardless or 1px border cards.
layouts.pricing: 3 standard pricing cards. Middle (monthly) card highlighted with secondary (Gold) border and badge.
layouts.gallery: Tetris grid layout (mixing col-span-2, row-span-2 for visual tension, avoid boring perfect squares).

motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion: initial opacity 0, y 20 -> whileInView opacity 1, y 0. Transition 0.5s ease. Stagger children for lists.
motion.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right (z-50), bg-green-500, continuous subtle pulse animation (animate-pulse or custom ping).
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (scale, color shift).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast on all text. Muted text must be #A3A3A3 or lighter.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React frontend using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Force a 'dark' theme aesthetic (base bg: #0A0A0A, text: #FFFFFF).
Implement the layout with specific sections in order: Hero, Sobre, Formatos, Benefícios, Planos, Depoimentos, Galeria, FAQ, and Footer CTA.
Write all copy in Brazilian Portuguese based on the user prompt.
Use Shadcn Accordion for the FAQ section and generic raw HTML/Tailwind for cards to ensure sharp 1px borders.
Integrate Lucide React for all iconography (benefits, contact, checkmarks in pricing).
Never use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions (e.g., `transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out`).
Do not use generic Inter/Roboto fonts. Apply Bebas Neue for headers and Barlow for body.
Ensure the fixed WhatsApp floating button has a pulse animation and links to `https://wa.me/5511999999999` (placeholder).
DO NOT use `.App { text-align: center; }`. Keep text alignment deliberate (mostly left-aligned for readability, centered for specific pricing/hero headers only if needed).
Add `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, cards, and links to ensure testing compatibility.
For the hero overlay, ensure it is completely dark (bg-black/70+) so the white and red text pops.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize high-contrast, 'tactical minimalism' aesthetic. Use deep black backgrounds (#0A0A0A), red/gold accents, 1px borders instead of soft shadows. Create a dense, focused vibe suitable for a Muaythai coach. The page must feel energetic, raw, and professional. Avoid 'AI slop' by using aggressive asymmetry in the About and Gallery sections.
